ValidationRule.description: For Travel. When Probability is >=0.30 the Account Industry should be updated to *Travel Operator”, “DMC” or “Accommodations” at the Account record. SAL-1497 BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", RecordType.Name = 'Travel', Probability >=0.30, IsClosed = false, OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Account_Industry__c, 'Accommodations'))), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Account_Industry__c, 'DMC'))), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Account_Industry__c, 'Hospitality'))), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Account_Industry__c, 'Travel Operator')) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please go to the Account record and update the Account Industry to “Accommodations”, *DMC*, "Hospitality" or "Travel Operator”
